text: In one sentence, what is a token?
A token is a small unit of text—such as a word, part of a word, punctuation mark, or symbol—that an AI model processes as input.
In one sentence, what is a token?
A token is a unit of text—such as a word, part of a word, punctuation mark, or symbol—that an AI model processes as input or output.
In one sentence, what is a token?
A token is a discrete unit of text—such as a word, part of a word, punctuation mark, or symbol—that an AI model processes.
In one sentence, what is an API?
An API (Application Programming Interface) is a set of rules and tools that allows different software applications to communicate and share functionality.
